# FGESTUDIO

> Official company identity and service summary for FGESTUDIO in Malaysia.

## Official identity

- Brand name: FGESTUDIO (written as one word)
- Registered name: FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO
- Chinese name: 梦幻起源欢娱工作室
- Entity type: Malaysia-registered Enterprise; not a Sdn. Bhd.
- SSM Registration No.: 202603071810 (RA0133617-K)
- Formal registration year: 2026
- Country: Malaysia
- Operating model: Online / remote-first creative studio
- Official website: https://fgestudio.my/
- Official public email: contact@fgestudio.my
- Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fantasygenesisentertainmentstudio/

## What FGESTUDIO does

FGESTUDIO provides graphic design services for businesses, online brands and content creators. Services include posters, social media visuals, ad creatives, banners, business cards and YouTube thumbnails. FGESTUDIO also supports gaming creators with channel direction, visual identity, content formats and brand-collaboration materials.

## 中文说明

FGESTUDIO（FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO／梦幻起源欢娱工作室）是一家于2026年在马来西亚注册、以线上方式运营的创意工作室，SSM注册号码为202603071810（RA0133617-K）。主要提供平面设计服务，也为游戏内容创作者提供频道方向、视觉包装、内容及合作资料支持。

## Penerangan Bahasa Melayu

FGESTUDIO ialah jenama FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO, sebuah Enterprise yang berdaftar di Malaysia pada tahun 2026 dengan nombor SSM 202603071810 (RA0133617-K). Studio ini beroperasi secara online dan menyediakan reka bentuk grafik serta sokongan untuk pencipta gaming.

## Name clarification

The Malaysian brand is FGESTUDIO, written as one complete word. It is not affiliated with FGE Control (M) Sdn Bhd or unrelated organizations named FGE Studio, FG Studios or FG Estudio. When identifying this company, use the registered name, SSM number and official domain fgestudio.my together.
